summary.text: Caleb Ness is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 82 in the November 3, 2026 general election and previously represented the district from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Ness as a member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 82, taking office on December 6, 2022, and leaving on December 3, 2024.
He succeeded Randall Greenwood and was followed by Nathan Wadsworth, and he did not run for re-election in 2024.
In the 2023-2024 term he was assigned to the Innovation, Development, Economic Advancement and Business Committee, which has since been decommissioned.
Ness advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and faces Democrat Chris Lewey in the general election.
